value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a classical natural 18-vertex cubic symmetric incidence graph. Its exact synchronous-majority transient depth, recurrent-core geometry, orbit-level basin classification and unequal basin sizes give a complete, mathematically motivated invariant set for a natural finite dynamical system; such an exact finite result can be valuable without extrapolation to an infinite graph family.

final_claim: For synchronous binary open-neighbor majority on the labelled 18-vertex Pappus Levi graph, the full map satisfies F⁵=F³ and F⁴≠F²; there are exactly 92 fixed configurations and 4,186 primitive temporal two-cycle orbits, with all 262,144 initial states periodic by update three. A 92-symbol shore core with P² fiber sizes 54×2, 36×4, 2×130 gives the complete fixed/two-cycle basin-size and first-entry tables.
